description.en: Original genus-level Cloudina fossil-skeletal-fragment study, consistent with original fossil-specimen inventory. Primary Wood,Ivantsov,Zhuravlev2017 Fig2b skeletal specimen photograph by Shuhai Xiao informs nested eccentric funnels; not photo replica, scan, species/locality-specific specimen or whole living organism. Two broken ends intentionally bound a fragment and do not assert natural open basal apex. Nominal12mm fragment length and3.5mm approximate maximum width illustrative, not source measurement. Pale carbonate color, posture and hidden inner surface simplified artistic choices; exact micrometre laminae not resolved. Whole-animal affinity and life position remain uncertain.
